content.text: {"page":"Read me","components":[],"texts":[{"id":"10:84","text":"READ ME"},{"id":"10:85","text":"How DesignChamp uses the kit"},{"id":"10:86","text":"The kit is the vocabulary of what Instapage builds natively. It makes an approved landing-page direction explicit enough to build, without letting the vocabulary decide the design. DesignChamp decides; the kit only guarantees the result stays native and editable."},{"id":"10:89","text":"Layer 1 · this file"},{"id":"10:90","text":"Neutral native primitives. Publish it as a TRAFFIK team library so client libraries can use it."},{"id":"10:91","text":"Never add a client color, face, button style or layout here."},{"id":"10:93","text":"Layer 2 · client library"},{"id":"10:94","text":"One Figma library per client, e.g. \"<Client> · Instapage components\", built from the client's approved sources."},{"id":"10:95","text":"Client components wrap Layer 1 instances: <Client> / Hero / Lead Form, <Client> / Proof / Metrics, <Client> / CTA / Primary."},{"id":"10:96","text":"Recorded in projects/<client>/client/design-library.md."},{"id":"10:98","text":"Layer 3 · project spec"},{"id":"10:99","text":"The approved page for one assignment, composed from the client library and Layer 1."},{"id":"10:100","text":"Project decisions stay project decisions unless promoted."},{"id":"10:103","text":"EXPLORE"},{"id":"10:104","text":"Do not use the kit. Explore the idea freely: strange, rough, unbuildable is fine."},{"id":"10:105","text":"Nothing is killed for being hard to build."},{"id":"10:107","text":"DEVELOP"},{"id":"10:108","text":"For serious directions, check each section maps to a native structure. Push the native range before asking for an exception."},{"id":"10:109","text":"Mark gaps with IP · Exception annotations: warnings, not verdicts."},{"id":"10:111","text":"JUDGE"},{"id":"10:112","text":"The spec is buildable natively, or every gap has a proposed exception with native options listed."},{"id":"10:113","text":"creative-engine-director sees the gaps before approving production."},{"id":"10:115","text":"PRODUCTION"},{"id":"10:116","text":"Mandatory. The approved spec uses Layer 1 instances (directly or inside client components) and is fully annotated."},{"id":"10:117","text":"instapage-production turns it into a build sheet, lints it and builds natively."},{"id":"10:120","text":"Building a spec"},{"id":"10:121","text":"1. Duplicate the Spec template page into the project's file."},{"id":"10:122","text":"2. Each section is a block frame: B01, B02 … in page order."},{"id":"10:123","text":"3. Fluid Grid blocks use Figma grid layout; each container is an auto-layout frame with a mobile order."},{"id":"10:124","text":"4. Every element is a Layer 1 instance, or sits inside a client component made of them."},{"id":"10:125","text":"5. Annotate. Draw mobile. Name the version."},{"id":"10:127","text":"Layer names"},{"id":"10:128","text":"Block:  B01 · Hero · Fluid Grid"},{"id":"10:129","text":"Container:  B01.C1 · m1   (m = mobile stacking order)"},{"id":"10:130","text":"Element:  E01 · Headline h1"},{"id":"10:131","text":"Image:  E04 · Image · IMG-01"},{"id":"10:132","text":"IDs match the build sheet, so nothing is re-typed by hand."},{"id":"10:134","text":"Annotation categories"},{"id":"10:135","text":"IP · Build: primitive and settings that are not visible (link target, visibility, sticky)."},{"id":"10:136","text":"IP · Copy: the approved copy ID for the text on this layer."},{"id":"10:137","text":"IP · Asset: asset ID and status (PLACEHOLDER / PRODUCTION-APPROVED)."},{"id":"10:138","text":"IP · Reuse: Page-local, My Block, or Global Block with its reason."},{"id":"10:139","text":"IP · Exception: EXC ID for anything not native."},{"id":"10:141","text":"Never"},{"id":"10:142","text":"A CreativeEngine-branded component or a house landing-page look."},{"id":"10:143","text":"Another client's library, blocks, assets or patterns as a starting point."},{"id":"10:144","text":"A template or saved block chosen because it is \"closest\": the spec decides."},{"id":"10:145","text":"Custom-coded components, text inside images, shapes inside Fluid Grid blocks."},{"id":"10:146","text":"Generated imagery, or copy not approved by WordSmither."},{"id":"10:147","text":"Source of truth: .claude/skills/instapage-production/references/ (figma-kit.md, platform.md, native-authorability.md, reusable-blocks.md). If this page and those files disagree, the files win."}],"annotations":[]}
